message: Vector Rebel 3.2.91: working update/result review, BC two-month station sections, and Captain PPE chart first.
releaseNotes: BC Check now displays all C-shift tour columns across the previous and current month, grouped by month, including future tours as NOT DUE rather than missing. Current-day citywide roster includes explicitly confirmed OFF members; station grouping begins with Battalion Chief then Station 1, 2, 3 and onward. Native PPE completions are summarized per person and tour as ALL COMPLETED, PARTIAL, NOT COMPLETED when a post-tour complete native history supports it, OFF when confirmed, or NOT VERIFIED/UNKNOWN otherwise. Completed with a confirmed failed answer is highlighted ISSUE, and completion-only without answer verdict is distinguished from a safety PASS. Existing BC review persists working and explicit OFF selections locally. Two-month historical reads use bounded pairs of existing C-shift read-only reports and do not submit official inspections, edit CrewSense, or send emails. Beta candidate pending signed-in field acceptance. Master Check for Update now shows a visible installed-versus-published version result or a concrete failure rather than silently changing a hidden notice. Software Issues Review All uses an actual async wait helper rather than throwing an unhandled wait-is-not-defined error after the first response; it displays progress and final acknowledged/error counts in the open dialog. The separate Captain cancellation path also uses the defined delay helper. Existing detailed error reports are kept, and acknowledgement never implies an underlying defect is fixed. Daily Captain Check now puts the original two-month person-by-item native PPE grid directly beneath a short summary; verbose current-tour statistics, history explanations and Scout attendance details are preserved in a collapsed 'More details' section below the chart. BC Check groups rows under BC then Station 1 onward, shows every visible scheduled firefighter with explicit UNKNOWN/NOT VERIFIED where native PPE evidence is absent, and reads existing owner-authorized CrewSense day evidence for the full two-month tour window in scoped read-only batches to show OFF only when both days have trusted full-leave/deployment coverage. The user-facing table never fabricates department-wide completed inspections from C-shift pilot records. This changes display/reconciliation only; it cannot create missing live native history for other stations without a separate authenticated background collector.
